compiled_state.description:
### 2. Incident Overview
* **Scenario Type:** Deferred Review Nitpick (surfaced during 6d7f fix-bug)
#### Expected Behavior
test-merge-to-main-spent-classifier.sh::t_restage_noop_emits_noop / t_restage_noop_rc_zero (ef39's _restage_execute empty-fresh-branch no-op tests) should pass hermetically regardless of ambient repo state.
#### Actual Behavior
They PASS in CI (PR #704 Script Tests green) but FAIL locally in a worktree that has ambient leftover staged-* branches + stashes. Verified the failure reproduces on clean origin/main HEAD locally (independent of the 6d7f changes). Likely the DSO_RESTAGE_EXECUTE=1 _restage_execute path or the topology fixture reads real-origin/ambient state instead of a fully-isolated fixture. Low severity (CI green); test-isolation hardening. Relates to ef39 (test author) + 3274 (_restage_execute hardening).

comments.body: Investigation COMPLETE (BASIC, dso:investigator-basic, high confidence). ROOT_CAUSE: merge-to-main-pr.sh:1448 RETURN trap uses rmdir '$_lockdir' which silently fails on the non-empty lockdir (pid file written at line 1400 by _restage_acquire_lock makes it non-empty), so the mkdir-lock ${TMPDIR}/dso-restage-main.lock.d is NEVER released on _restage_execute return. Stale lockdir with a dead PID accumulates; when that PID is reused/appears-live, _restage_acquire_lock spins 60s then returns 1 -> _restage_execute RC=1 with no NO-OP message -> t_restage_noop_emits_noop + t_restage_noop_rc_zero FAIL. The checkpoint's ambient-staged-* hypothesis was DISPROVED empirically (outer staged-* branches do not bleed into the fixture; cd $work isolates correctly). Inconsistency note: line 1387 (stale-lock reclaim) already uses rm -rf; only the RETURN trap at 1448 uses rmdir. FIX: 1448 rmdir -> rm -rf. Complexity TRIVIAL; testing_mode=RED (new test asserting lock release on return). Hypothesis Validation Gate: PASS (3 confirmed dynamic tests, root-cause-consistent, names actionable artifact).

comments.body: Anti-pattern scan complete: 1 confirmed candidate (the fixed file), 0 other occurrences. Scanned all rmdir-on-mkdir-lock sites (ticket-lib.sh:382, ticket-init.sh:241, deps.sh:294, cleanup-claude-session.sh:192). All others are SAFE: they are bare mutex locks (no file written into the lockdir, so rmdir-on-empty succeeds) or intentional remove-if-empty semantics. merge-to-main-pr.sh was the ONLY site writing a pid file INTO the lockdir while releasing with rmdir. No broader sweep needed. Fix verified GREEN: 26/26 suite pass, lockdir absent post-suite, shellcheck clean at CI bar (--severity=warning, exit 0); 6 pre-existing SC2004 style findings unrelated/out-of-scope.
